Pro trial · Day 7 · FAQ

Not another indicator pack.

Halfway through the Pro trial. Straight answers — then one job.

Objection

“Is this just another zip of oscillators?”

No. It’s a pair of chart workspaces with one language — zone / lock / strike — and a panel that can take only the strike you authorize. You keep your process. Nothing replaces your judgment.

Why Pro exists

By hand, you press when STRIKE prints. With Auto armed, the panel can take that same strike — no missed entries, control still yours. Base keeps the charts. Pro keeps Auto and the desk tools.

Today’s job

On a quiet session, arm Auto once so you know what you’d be keeping after day 14. No pay ask today.
